entry.title: New: dsh-screen-agent
entry.summary: Desktop and web automation: 📸 multi-screen screenshots, 🔍 Windows OCR (text + pixel coordinates), 🖱️ mouse click/drag, ⌨️ Chinese typing/keys, and 🪟 window activation, with battle-tested drawing in Paint (mouse acceleration compensation, canvas positioning, Bézier curves). Exact install spec: github:lak321/dsh-screen-agent. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
